params.name: in
params.description: The list of comma-separated user IDs generated by a trusted service.

params.name: sig
params.description: The signature of this request generated by a trusted service.

items.docs: Retrieves a list of users referenced by a trusted service. Clients cannot construct the URL themselves. The correct URL will be provided in the HAL links of another API response, in the _links object with a key like ref:users:0.
